2608.29582.title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
2608.29582.paper_summary: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.
2608.29582.paper_summary_zh: 目前對大型語言模型（LLMs）的評估主要集中在事實知識檢索上，忽略了在臨床指標與診斷之間導航複雜的非雙射映射的根本挑戰。現有的基準無法評估大型語言模型是否真正具備在診斷模糊情境中所需的推理能力，這種情境中相同的臨床表現可能對應於不同的病因，而診斷收斂情境中，異質症狀最終指向相同的疾病。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SUP-MIMIC，一個利用MIMIC-IV-v3.1的多任務框架，包括基本評估（BA）、診斷分歧任務（DDT）和診斷收斂任務（DCT）。具體而言，DDT旨在評估模型在表型相似案例中的「一對多」消歧能力，而DCT則評估模型識別不同病理生理途徑中「多對一」診斷模式的能力。對最先進的LLMs進行的全面評估顯示，與基準任務相比，DDT和DCT的性能顯著下降，暴露出對統計捷徑的系統性依賴，而非真正的因果推理。我們的研究結果進一步突顯了對「健康」預測的保守偏見，這意味著在現實醫療環境中漏診的風險並不輕微。這項工作建立了一種嚴謹的方法論，用於量化臨床推理的穩健性，並提供了一個增強語言模型在臨床醫學中安全性的路線圖。
